name: Common-questions bank
acceptanceCriteria: /college-interviews/questions/harvard-undergrad page renders a school-specific title referencing Harvard
Questions are grouped into at least 3 themed sections
Each question is distinctly styled from its surrounding prose
A back link to /college-interviews is visible
Questions page link is accessible from the college interview setup page once a school is picked
antiPatterns: Questions rendered as a flat bulleted list with no theme grouping
Page 404s when the schoolId is valid

screenshots.expect: The /college-interviews/questions/harvard-undergrad page showing themed question groups
